title: Phosphorus Supplements
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for phosphorus supplements.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from clinical studies supports the safety and efficacy of phosphorus supplementation primarily in correcting deficiency states such as hypophosphatemia; evidence for supplementation benefits in the general population is limited; safety concerns justify cautious use especially in renal impairment.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
